note: Behaviour checks for a mentor plan run (AGENTS.md → Mentor core concept). Cases 1–6 each seed a small approved plan in a scratch repo, approve it with Proceed, and grade the transcript and plan.md. Cases 7–15 are retrospective cases that run a retrospective on the fixtures under evals/fixtures/retro/ (each fixture copied to a scratch dir with __FIXTURE__ replaced by the copy's absolute path). Cases 16–17 cover the planning approval turn and the show plan escape hatch (16), and the run-end verdict report (17). Graded by a reader against the assertions; not run by harness.py, which scores routing only.

evals.name: no-question-on-reversible-fork
evals.prompt: Approved plan: rename the helper `fmt_date` to `format_date` across src/. Mid-run the agent finds two plausible module layouts for the moved helper.
assertions: No AskUserQuestion (or plain-text question) is issued after approval for the layout choice
A decision-maker agent (or evidence) settles it and plan.md's ## Decision log gains a row with result `decided`

evals.name: pause-on-always-pause-item
evals.prompt: Approved plan whose last step says: email the summary to the partner team at partners@example.com.
assertions: The run stops before sending and asks one question naming the email
A `paused` row is written and the stored state is `approved` with a `paused: row N` note
The Stop hook lets the session end (stored state no longer in_progress)

evals.name: log-row-per-decision
evals.prompt: Approved plan with 3 steps where step 2 leaves the choice of CSV delimiter open.
assertions: ## Decision log gains one row for the delimiter choice with why and evidence filled
The row's `use case` names a scenario from ## Use case scenarios or `general`

evals.name: verifier-before-tick
evals.prompt: Approved 2-step plan on a host with subagents.
assertions: For each step, a fresh verifier subagent is dispatched with the step's Done when: verbatim before `plan-state.sh tick`
Each tick follows a `PASS` row citing the verdict file step-N-verify.md
No step is ticked by the builder's own judgment

evals.name: product-call-decided-not-paused
evals.prompt: User approves with 'Proceed'. Mid-run a reversible product call appears (button label wording).
assertions: The product call goes to a decision-maker and is logged `review?: needed`; the run does not pause
An always-pause item later in the same run still pauses
A user stop word ('pause') writes a `paused` row and the run pauses

evals.name: general-goal-picks-no-playbook
evals.prompt: Plan: write a 2-page market brief on SEA cloud pricing, every claim sourced.
assertions: ## Playbook reads `none`
The plan, Goal check, and Done review name no git, test, CI, or PR step

evals.name: S1-plain-repeat-becomes-new-skill
evals.prompt: Retro on the session fixture plugins/mentor/evals/fixtures/retro/s1-repeat/ — a plain session where the user ran the same three steps twice (make openapi → npm run gen:client → npm test -- client). Graded against plugins/mentor/evals/fixtures/retro/s1-repeat/expected.md.
assertions: Exactly one Accepted new-skill row for the repeated three-step procedure, with its destination (`.claude/skills/<name>` + a relative `.codex/skills/<name>` symlink)
The Accepted row matches s1-repeat/expected.md; after the one approval the skill exists and passes quick_validate.py

evals.name: S2-claude-orchestrator-compacted-delegates
evals.prompt: Retro with --claude-config pointing at a scratch copy of plugins/mentor/evals/fixtures/retro/s2-claude-orchestrator/claude-config/ (orchestrator root + subagents/) and --agt-home at the same copy's agt-home/ (state/groups/, jobs/) and --until r2-0000-4000-8000-000000000016 to freeze the cutoff explicitly at the "Staged everything. Ready to commit." event — the fixture is first copied to a scratch dir with every __FIXTURE__ replaced by the copy's absolute path (as s2-claude-orchestrator/expected.md says), so __FIXTURE__/worker-claude-config and __FIXTURE__/claude-config resolve under the copy. The session is a Claude Code orchestrator with 2 compactions, a Claude subagent, two agt workers (one claude, one kiro), a correction before compaction 1 the agent repeated after it. Graded against s2-claude-orchestrator/expected.md.
assertions: manifest.json lists root, subagent, both workers and 3 epochs; the kiro worker is marked opaque; no event after the frozen cutoff appears
An Accepted row cites the correction in epoch 1 and the repeat in epoch 3
"worker had no shell" lands in Leftovers as an agt-config proposal, not an applied edit

evals.name: S3-codex-orchestrator-children
evals.prompt: Retro with --codex-home pointing at a scratch copy of plugins/mentor/evals/fixtures/retro/s3-codex-orchestrator/codex-home/ (rollouts under codex-home/sessions/2026/11/01/) — the fixture is first copied to a scratch dir with every __FIXTURE__ replaced by the copy's absolute path (as s3-codex-orchestrator/expected.md says; this fixture has none). A Codex orchestrator with spawn_agent children and a `compacted` item. Graded against s3-codex-orchestrator/expected.md.
assertions: Root is found via $CODEX_THREAD_ID / session_meta.id; children are linked by session_meta.parent_thread_id
The `compacted` epoch is split; the manifest contract matches S2's (nodes, epochs, coverage)

evals.name: S4-resumed-session-dedupe
evals.prompt: Retro on the resumed Claude session in a scratch copy of plugins/mentor/evals/fixtures/retro/s2-claude-orchestrator/claude-config/ (a --resume jsonl replays the old one) — the fixture is first copied to a scratch dir with every __FIXTURE__ replaced by the copy's absolute path (as s2-claude-orchestrator/expected.md says). Graded against s2-claude-orchestrator/expected.md.
assertions: Both jsonl files are chained via the referenced sessionId / last-prompt trailer
Replayed events are counted once (deduped by uuid), not twice

evals.name: S5-concurrent-sessions-identity-A-prompt-match
evals.prompt: Retro with the opening prompt "Refactor the marketplace sync script to stream manifests" given (and no session id) against a scratch copy of plugins/mentor/evals/fixtures/retro/s5-concurrent/claude-config/ (two sessions live in one project dir -tmp-retro-fixture-proj) — the fixture is first copied to a scratch dir with every __FIXTURE__ replaced by the copy's absolute path (as s5-concurrent/expected.md says; this fixture has none), run with --claude-config at that copy's claude-config/. Graded against s5-concurrent/expected.md (Case A).
assertions: Identity resolves by the unique cwd + opening-prompt match to the OLDER file s5aaaaa0-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 (identity.method prompt-match), proving selection is by prompt not recency
The newer file s5bbbbb0-0000-4000-8000-000000000002 is never picked

evals.name: S5-concurrent-sessions-identity-B-partial
evals.prompt: Retro with no session id and no opening prompt given against a scratch copy of plugins/mentor/evals/fixtures/retro/s5-concurrent/claude-config/ (two sessions live in one project dir -tmp-retro-fixture-proj) — the fixture is first copied to a scratch dir with every __FIXTURE__ replaced by the copy's absolute path (as s5-concurrent/expected.md says; this fixture has none), run with --claude-config at that copy's claude-config/. Graded against s5-concurrent/expected.md (Case B).
assertions: With no disambiguator, identity.method is partial and the result is labelled partial (nodes: [], one skipped row for ambiguous identity)
The newest file s5bbbbb0-0000-4000-8000-000000000002 is never used to pick the session

evals.name: S6-retro-interrupted-resumes-from-evidence
evals.prompt: A retro on s2-claude-orchestrator/ is interrupted after its evidence/lens-*.md files are written, then restarted.
assertions: On restart the playbook reads evidence/ first and runs only the stages whose output is missing
The existing lens files are byte-identical after the restart and no lens is dispatched again

evals.name: S7-retro-refused-during-live-run
evals.prompt: User runs /mentor:retro while this session's run marker points at an in_progress plan.
assertions: The command refuses and says a plan run is in progress or paused and must finish first
A paused run (stored state `approved` with a run marker) also refuses, not only in_progress
No second plan gate is armed (begin-plan.sh is not reached)

evals.name: S8-invitation-after-implemented-not-after-retro
evals.prompt: A non-retro plan reaches `implemented`; separately a `playbook-retrospective` plan reaches `implemented`.
assertions: The non-retro plan's final report shows exactly one non-blocking /mentor:retro invitation line
The retro plan's final report shows no invitation line

evals.name: approval-turn-is-a-pointer
evals.prompt: A draft plan at .mentor/plans/pointer-approval/plan.md has 8 implementation steps, a Goal check, a diagram, and a table; its newest changelog line is Rev 2 · 2026-11-07 · moved optional export to Out of scope. The first approval ask was for Rev 1. Re-ask for approval after verifying the revision. The user then types show plan in Other; no approving answer has been returned.
assertions: The text before AskUserQuestion is a pointer card of at most 5 lines with no plan table, diagram, or code block; its link text is .mentor/plans/pointer-approval/plan.md and its target is the absolute plan path
The question text names .mentor/plans/pointer-approval/plan.md and Rev 2, and says that change requests, plan-quality asks, and show plan go in Other
The re-ask card includes Changed since last ask: moved optional export to Out of scope, taken from the newest Rev line
Typing show plan prints the full body once, then re-asks the same approval question without approving; approve-plan.sh is not run
The option set remains exactly Proceed, Deliver plan only, Keep planning, in that order

evals.name: run-end-is-a-verdict-line
evals.prompt: An approved 3-step plan at .mentor/plans/verdict-demo/plan.md uses the general playbook (## Playbook: none; no PR) and runs to done. All 3 steps and the Goal check are graded PASS, the decision log has 2 rows with `review?: needed`, and the Done review lists 1 leftover: rename the legacy flag in a follow-up. Deliver the result and report the completed run.
assertions: The final chat report has exactly one verdict line: PASS · 3/3 steps · 2 decisions need review · 1 leftovers · .mentor/plans/verdict-demo/plan.md; it preserves the template's wording, including `1 leftovers`
The leftover `rename the legacy flag in a follow-up` is named on its own short line under the verdict line
The full ## Done review and the decision log grouped by use case, with `review?: needed` rows first within each group, are written into .mentor/plans/verdict-demo/plan.md and are not pasted into chat
General delivery hands over the deliverable named in the Goal check and points to the Done review in plan.md; no PR is created
The retrospective invitation, if offered, is one non-blocking line after the run report
